_comment: ids: the stable u16 id table for core records (index = id); append only, never reorder. Tile-anchored decorations (view/actors/dressing_view.gd). id -> model (res:// literal, fetched by tools/fetch_assets.sh), footprint [w, h] in tiles (the cells it covers, left-bottom at the record's x, y), anchor (ground: stands on the solid tile below its footprint; ceiling: hangs under the solid tile above it), fit_h (height above the model's origin, in tiles, it is scaled to: robust to packs cooked in cm), z (its plane, in tiles: negative behind the actors at 0, positive in front; terrain blocks span -0.5..0.5), depth (z squash, so a round tree does not poke through the terrain front face), jitter (random scale +-, per placement), lod (which of a Synty model's LOD meshes to draw: some of the nature packs' LOD0 trees run to 30000 triangles), gap (columns to the next object in this pass, if wider than the footprint: a tree stands on one column of a slope and keeps its distance), where (biomes, band surface | cave, on: tile names it may stand on or hang from), weight (relative frequency for scatter), tint (hex, optional), textures ({material name: png or #hex colour, or * for untextured materials: png}: restores an atlas a cooked file lost). Records are {id, x, y}; tiles stay the truth. Places pieces (band "place"; never scattered): still (no random yaw), turn (degrees of yaw), anchor wall (hangs on a back wall: every footprint cell open with a background wall). Placed by PlaceBuilder through data/places/kits.json. prim: the same object from primitives (view/actors/prim_mesh.gd), drawn when the model is not fetched or the row has none. Rows with where.band below are the underground regions' own (view/actors/region_dressing.gd, see the below table): where.biomes names regions, where.chance replaces the region's density (a drow row, in any region), light {level, y, color}: the picture's light of a glowing prop (view/below_look.gd), never a rule's.

density._doc: Chance per surface column to try an object, by biome; under: the same for the second pass (objects with where.pass under, on their own footprints, so they sit among the first pass).

ponds._doc: Pools of water tile on level ground that is not a road or a place, which on a settled world is little of it: roads run along most of the surface. every: one try per this many columns. width: columns of water; the rim is one row deep, the middle depth rows, so a body walks in and out.

road._doc: Where the road is the surface, a level stretch of it goes under one row of water and the road's path with it: wading depth, a ford with no river. on: the road's tile. gap: columns of road left dry after a stretch that was looked at. width: columns of water; a stretch needs one level column more each side.

below._doc: The underground regions' own dressing: rows with where.band below, drawn from the tiles by view/actors/region_dressing.gd, not core records, so they never move a world. where.biomes names regions (BiomeIds.region_at), where.on the tile they stand on or, anchor ceiling, hang from. density: the chance a floor or ceiling cell of a region tries; ceiling: a ceiling cell's share of that; field_lights: glowing props the picture's light field carries at once, nearest the focus. A row with no fetched model draws its prim (view/actors/prim_mesh.gd).
